verdict.rationale: Adyen documents API equivalents for several Customer Area actions. The Management API orders terminals "using API requests instead of the Customer Area", the Terminal API handles payments and refunds that can also be issued from the Customer Area, a Disputes API exists, and API definitions are published as OpenAPI on GitHub. However, nothing states general API-to-UI parity, and coverage of terminal and transaction management is shown only piecemeal. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that every Customer Area/UI action is exposed via API, documented API coverage of terminal configuration and branding management, and independent or hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Management API lets you order terminals and accessories for delivery to a location of your choice using API requests instead of the Customer Area.
The Adyen Terminal API lets you make payments, issue refunds, collect shopper information, and perform other shopper-terminal interactions using a payment terminal supplied by Adyen.
You can also issue refunds from your Customer Area
You can retrieve dispute information, defend or accept disputes, and upload defense documents.
This repository contains Adyen API definition files, represented in the OpenAPI Specification standard
